Order

WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SACHIN SHANKAR MAGADUM  ORAL ORDER

This petition is filed seeking quashing of the proceedings pending in C.C.No.341/2018 arising out of the Crime No.21/2018 of Hebbagodi Police for the alleged offences punishable under Sections 406 and 420 of IPC on the file of the learned IV Additional Civil Judge and JMFC at Anekal.
Learned counsel for respondent No.2 has produced the order passed by the Co-ordinate Bench in Crl.P.No.8532/2018.
Citing this order, he would contend that this is the second petition.
Though this is a fit case to impose exemplary cost, however, this Court is inclined to take a lenient view.
The second petition seeking quashing of the proceedings is not maintainable in view of the dismissal of the criminal petition filed on the earlier occasion.
In view of the above, the criminal petition is dismissed.
